introHtml: Plastic webcam covers offer a lightweight, durable solution for protecting employee privacy while keeping your logo visible. Unlike metal or silicone options, these slim covers slide easily over laptop cameras without adding bulk. They are ideal for remote work kits, onboarding swag, or safety giveaways. With full-color imprinting available, you can turn a simple privacy tool into a subtle brand reminder that travels with your team wherever they work.
heroAltText: Custom plastic webcam covers with company logo, sliding over a laptop camera for privacy and branding
